propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate has been the Group Product Manager for a SaaS company's developer platform since 2022, managing its three product managers, after product manager and senior product manager roles on the company's API products from 2016 to 2022, nine years of product management in all with three years managing product managers.
propositions.rationale: The resume documents the roles, the years and the management span.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate owns the pricing and packaging of the platform's API tiers with the commercial team, with two tier changes approved on pricing proposals under her name, and set the platform roadmap with the product director while running the quarterly roadmap review with engineering leadership.
propositions.rationale: The resume, the pricing proposal and the review deck document the pricing ownership and the roadmap work.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate coached the three product managers under the product group's coaching practice and wrote the roadmap boundary sections and the open decisions lists after each quarterly review.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the growth plan document the coaching and the boundary documents.

expectedGap: None; the materials document the years, the management span, the pricing ownership, the roadmap work and the coaching.
expectedBoundaryNote: The years by role and the pricing ownership are documented in the resume and the pricing proposal; keep the management span as stated.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask for the product folder references of the two pricing proposals to confirm the proposer field.
